# Nusajawa Clove

> Nusajawa Clove is an Indonesian grower-exporter of export-grade whole clove (Indonesian: cengkeh; Syzygium aromaticum). It grows clove on its own plantations in Nganjuk, East Java, sources all supply from East Java, has its office in Kediri, and all cargo ships from the port of Surabaya to importers, distributors and manufacturers in 15+ countries.

## Key facts

- Products: two grades of whole clove.
  - Whole Clove Select (Super Grade A): moisture ≤ 10%, eugenol ≥ 85%, essential oil ≥ 18%, foreign matter ≤ 1%, minimum order 1 MT.
  - Whole Clove Standard (Grade A): moisture ≤ 12%, eugenol ≥ 72%, essential oil ≥ 15%, minimum order 1 MT.
- Annual capacity: 20 T.
- Own plantations: Nganjuk, East Java. All supply comes from East Java, Indonesia. Office: Kediri, East Java.
- Loading port: Surabaya.
- Packaging: 50 kg jute sack, 500 kg jumbo bag, custom / OEM on request.
- Documents per shipment: Phytosanitary Certificate (Ministry of Agriculture), Certificate of Analysis per batch, Halal Certificate (MUI), Certificate of Origin (Chamber of Commerce), Health Certificate on request.
- Testing: every lot is inspected by an in-house team and an accredited third-party laboratory before shipment.
- Export markets include Saudi Arabia, UAE, India, Pakistan, China, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Germany, Netherlands, United Kingdom and United States.
- Contact: export@nusajawa.id, WhatsApp / phone +62 857-5586-9860, Monday to Friday 08:00-17:00 WIB. Prices are quoted on request within one business day.
